fields.statement: Verifier at c6d5008c: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(health-load-hold|describe-golden|health.*)$' passes. health-load-hold.txtar writes .git/rhiza/daemon.state.json with a load-high hold since RHIZA_TEST_NOW-29m (load part ok) and -31m (warn 'new runs held for 31m0s (load-high): 1-minute load 4.00 per core, over the limit of 3.00', next 'rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxLoad'), and the same for memory-low with rhiza.daemon.minMemory. Read the diff: healthLoad in internal/api/health.go warns at >=30m naming hold age, reason and the daemon's Detail (reading and limit, same format as daemon.Evaluate), with the matching setting as next step; otherwise ok with current load/memory readings and limits. A scratch-built binary in a scratch repo showed the warn with a 45m memory hold and the ok line with readings and limits without one.
